purpose: Manual source-checklist audit of second first-article iteration; diagnostic, not benchmark answer accuracy.
verdict: Participants and reported product/offer facts are now linked; prose Claims are absent. Numeric values and comparison counterparts are still often buried in strings. One uncertain exact price is unnecessarily weakened to approximately. Empty document headings consumed 62 tool calls in the final section, creating no product facts. Do not equate 107 relation instances with 107 supported domain assertions.
further_limitations: Most electronics use a broad Consumer Electronics class; taxonomy is shallow.
Nearly all predicates are article-reporting schemas; routes through shared products exist, but usefulness against text-only retrieval remains unmeasured.
This graph was reviewed with source checklist, not future questions or answer labels.
